step1_analysis.circuit_type: Mixed-signal FIR filter tap / Multiplying DAC
step1_analysis.description: The circuit acts as a mixed-signal multiplier for an FIR filter tap. It uses a synapse pFET (XM7) to store an analog weight on its floating gate (N5) and NMOS switches to steer current based on a digital input (N0), effectively multiplying the input by the stored weight.

paper_reference.title: A Mixed-Signal Approach to High-Performance Low-Power Linear Filters

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the multiplier cell during operation

sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for Sky130 1.8V supply from the paper's 3.3V supply.

operating_frequency.description: Maximum operating frequency of the filter tap

sky130_expected.calculation: Sky130 can easily exceed 200MHz for 0.5um channel lengths.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Maintained the paper's target frequency as a baseline, though the modern process can likely go faster.

voltage_swing_n4.description: Voltage swing at internal node N4

sky130_expected.calculation: N4 is pulled up by an NMOS cascode (XM8) with its gate at 0.9V. Max voltage = Vbias - Vth = 0.9V - 0.42V = 0.48V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the NMOS threshold voltage drop from the 0.9V bias.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power consumption and internal voltage swings at 200 MHz operation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Mixed-Signal Multiplier / FIR Tap
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N2 N3 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 N0 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N3 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N4 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 N1 LABEL_NET_2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N5 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 LABEL_NET_4 N4 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9

* 200 MHz input signal
VIN N0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 2.4n 5n)

* High-value resistor to prevent floating node errors on the synapse floating gate
R_N5 N5 0 1G

.control
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure average power
  let inst_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  meas tran avg_power avg inst_power from=5n to=20n
  
  * Measure voltage swings at analog nodes
  meas tran v_n1_max max v(N1) from=5n to=20n
  meas tran v_n1_min min v(N1) from=5n to=20n
  
  meas tran v_n2_max max v(N2) from=5n to=20n
  meas tran v_n2_min min v(N2) from=5n to=20n
  
  meas tran v_n4_max max v(N4) from=5n to=20n
  meas tran v_n4_min min v(N4) from=5n to=20n
  
  print avg_power v_n1_max v_n1_min v_n2_max v_n2_min v_n4_max v_n4_min
  quit
.endc
.end
